accept_notification.doc: Accept a pending share notification and grant the shared node access to the current user. Calls yp_notification_accept to retrieve permission details, then calls sbx_accept to establish the MFS sharing relationship. Returns the accepted node attributes on success, or empty object if the notification has no status.

nid.description: Node ID of the share notification to accept

returns.description: MFS node attributes of the accepted shared node, or empty object if notification has no status

assign_permission.doc: Assign sharing permissions to one or more users (drumates or guests) for source nodes. Runs pre_assign preprocessing to validate emails, resolve drumate accounts, create guest accounts for unknown emails, and build the srcgrantlst. Then calls assign_drumate_permission and assign_guest_permission. Guests receive an email notification with a shareable link.

email.description: One or more recipient email addresses. Single string is auto-wrapped in array. Guests (unknown emails) get a DMZ share link by email. Drumates get an in-app notification.

privilege.description: Permission level to assign. Falls back to permission param if omitted.

permission.description: Permission level to assign if privilege is not provided.

message.description: Optional message to include in the sharing notification or email

days.description: Number of days for permission expiry. Combined with hours.

hours.description: Number of hours for permission expiry. Combined with days.

returns.description: Updated outbound node attributes after permissions have been assigned

errors.message: Source grant list is empty or no valid recipients found
errors.condition: srcgrantlst is empty or both drumates and guests lists are empty

errors.message: One or more email addresses are invalid
errors.condition: Email fails isEmail() validation; invalid emails returned in error payload

errors.message: One or more source nodes could not be found
errors.condition: Node in srclst is undefined or has no nid

copy_link.doc: Copy (clone) a share link for a node granting permission to the nobody/public user. Calls permission_grant with scope 'link' and retrieves the resulting node link data. Runs pre_link preprocessing to validate source nodes.

nid.description: Node ID (NODE_ID constant) to create a copy link for

permission.description: Permission level to grant on the link

message.description: Optional message stored on the permission record

days.description: Number of days for link expiry. Combined with hours.

hours.description: Number of hours for link expiry. Combined with days.

returns.description: Node link data from get_node_link for the nobody access record

copy_to_sb.doc: Copy source nodes to a sharebox outbound folder. Renames nodes via rename_trash to the sharebox outbound path, then triggers mfs_copy_all transaction. Runs pre_transact preprocessing. Requires owner permission on both src and dest hubs.

returns.description: Transaction result from mfs_copy_all

create_inbound_link.doc: Create an inbound drop link for specific recipient email addresses. Creates a subdirectory named after each email under the target node, sets up a DMZ share with upload permission for the nobody user, and sends an email to each recipient with the drop link. Runs pre_share_in preprocessing.

email.description: One or more recipient email addresses who will receive the inbound drop link. Single string is auto-wrapped in array.

nid.description: Parent node ID under which the inbound drop folder is created

days.description: Number of days for link expiry. Combined with hours.

hours.description: Number of hours for link expiry. Combined with days.

returns.description: Node data of the created inbound drop directory after email delivery

errors.message: MFS directory creation failed or DMZ share check returned empty

create_link.doc: Create an outbound share link for source nodes. Checks or creates a DMZ share token per node via dmz_check_share, grants permission with the given expiry and permission level, registers the link via dmz_add_link, and returns updated outbound node attributes. Runs pre_link preprocessing.

permission.description: Permission level to grant. Defaults to Permission.download if omitted.

days.description: Number of days for link expiry. Combined with hours.

hours.description: Number of hours for link expiry. Combined with days.

returns.description: Updated outbound node attributes for all linked nodes

create_private_box.doc: Create a private sharebox folder accessible only by a specific guest email. Verifies the email does not belong to an existing drumate, creates a guest account if needed, creates a named directory, sets metadata.sharebox='private', generates a DMZ share token, grants upload permission, and returns the box data with a shareable link.

email.description: Email address of the guest recipient. Must not be an existing drumate account.

permission.description: Permission level to grant. Defaults to Privilege.upload if omitted.

password.description: Optional password to protect the private box link

days.description: Number of days for link expiry. Default is 10 days.

hours.description: Number of hours for link expiry. Combined with days.

returns.description: Created private box share data with inbound link

link.description: Shareable inbound URL with the DMZ token as path segment

share_id.description: DMZ share token for the private box

errors.message: Email belongs to an existing drumate account and cannot be used for a guest private box
errors.condition: drumate_exists returns non-empty result for the provided email

errors.message: Failed to create the sharebox directory
DMZ share state mismatch; share exists in public state but private was expected

create_public_box.doc: Create a public sharebox folder accessible to anyone with the link. Creates a named directory in the user home, sets metadata.sharebox='private', generates a DMZ share token, grants permission for the wildcard user, and returns the box data with a shareable inbound link.

name.description: Display name for the public sharebox folder

permission.description: Permission level to grant. Defaults to Privilege.download if omitted.

password.description: Optional password to protect the public box link

days.description: Number of days for link expiry. Combined with hours.

hours.description: Number of hours for link expiry. Combined with days.

returns.description: Created public box share data with inbound link

link.description: Shareable inbound URL with the DMZ token as path segment

share_id.description: DMZ share token for the public box

errors.message: Failed to create the sharebox directory
DMZ share state mismatch; share exists in private state but public was expected

get_box_attr.doc: Get attributes and link for a sharebox node. Retrieves DMZ share link content via dmz_show_link_content and constructs the full inbound access URL including the share token.

nid.description: Node ID (NODE_ID constant) of the sharebox to retrieve attributes for

returns.description: Sharebox link content with constructed inbound URL

link.description: Full inbound shareable URL with the DMZ share token

get_inbound_node_attr.doc: Get inbound sharing attributes for one or more nodes. Returns sharing metadata for nodes shared inbound to the current user. Single nid string is auto-wrapped in array before the database call.

nid.description: One or more node IDs (NODE_ID constant). Single string is auto-wrapped in array.

returns.description: Inbound node sharing attributes from get_inbound_node_attr stored procedure

get_node_share_attr.doc: Get sharing attributes for a specific node with a given option context. Queries the sharebox database (sb_db from visitor context) for node share attributes visible to the current user.

nid.description: Node ID (NODE_ID constant) to retrieve sharing attributes for

option.description: Display option controlling which attributes are returned (e.g. view mode)

returns.description: Node sharing attributes from the sharebox database for the given node and option

get_outbound_node_attr.doc: Get outbound sharing attributes for one or more nodes. Returns sharing metadata for nodes the current user has shared outbound to others. Single nid string is auto-wrapped in array before the database call.

nid.description: One or more node IDs (NODE_ID constant). Single string is auto-wrapped in array.

returns.description: List of outbound node sharing attributes from get_outbound_node_attr stored procedure

notification_count.doc: Get count of pending sharebox notifications for the current user. The private implementation calls yp_notification_count; the public stub returns an empty object.

returns.description: Notification count data from yp_notification_count, or empty object in public context

notification_list.doc: Get list of pending sharebox notifications for the current user. The private implementation calls yp_notification_receive_list; the public stub returns an empty object.

returns.description: List of pending share notifications from yp_notification_receive_list, or empty object in public context

refuse_notification.doc: Refuse (decline) a pending share notification. Removes the notification via yp_notification_remove and returns the updated notification list for the current user.

nid.description: Node ID (NODE_ID constant) of the share notification to refuse

returns.description: Updated list of remaining pending notifications after refusal

remove_link.doc: Remove a share link for a node. Deletes the DMZ share record via dmz_delete_share using both the node ID and share ID, then returns updated outbound node attributes.

nid.description: Node ID of the shared node whose link is being removed

share_id.description: Share token ID of the link to delete

returns.description: Updated outbound node attributes after link removal

remove_open_link.doc: Remove an open (public) share link. Reserved endpoint for removing publicly accessible share links.

returns.description: Reserved

revoke_permission.doc: Revoke sharing permissions from one or more users for the preloaded source nodes. For each user and node combination: removes DMZ link if the user is a guest (not a drumate), removes the sharebox entry via sbx_remove if the user is a drumate, revokes the permission record, and removes any pending notification. Runs pre_revoke preprocessing to load source nodes.

user_id.description: One or more user IDs whose permissions should be revoked. Single string is auto-wrapped in array.

returns.description: Drumate lookup result for the last processed user ID

update_box.doc: Update the permission and expiry settings of an existing sharebox. Looks up the existing share via dmz_check_share and updates the permission grant and DMZ share record. Returns the updated box data with a refreshed inbound link.

nid.description: Node ID (NODE_ID constant) of the sharebox to update

permission.description: Updated permission level. Defaults to Privilege.upload if omitted.

password.description: Updated password for the sharebox link

days.description: Updated number of days for expiry. Combined with hours.

hours.description: Updated number of hours for expiry. Combined with days.

returns.description: Updated sharebox data with refreshed inbound link

link.description: Refreshed inbound shareable URL with DMZ token

errors.message: Node ID does not match any existing sharebox share record
errors.condition: dmz_check_share returns a new share_id equal to the generated random one, indicating no existing share was found

update_link.doc: Update permission and expiry for an existing share link identified by share ID. Accepts one or more node IDs, normalizes them, re-grants permission on each with the updated expiry and permission level using the existing share token, and returns updated outbound node attributes.

nid.description: One or more node IDs to update the link for. Normalized via normalize_ids.

share_id.description: Existing share token ID to update

permission.description: Updated permission level. Defaults to Permission.view if omitted.

days.description: Updated number of days for expiry. Combined with hours.

hours.description: Updated number of hours for expiry. Combined with days.

returns.description: Updated outbound node attributes after permission re-grant
